scope: Read-only hardware/SDK inspection and official documentation research; no original code, configs or system services changed; no project rendering benchmark started.

priorities.direction: Verify physical GPU isolation of interactive preview and formal capture, including SDK/CUDA data devices
mechanisms: actual callback device and transfer evidence
priorities.gain: Expected responsiveness improvement, not yet measured on dual GPU

priorities.direction: Bound and budget CPU worker pools for actual 28-core cgroup quota
priorities.gain: Avoid oversubscription; exact best thread counts require controlled trials

priorities.direction: Separate interactive asynchronous viewport rendering from synchronous frozen formal capture
mechanisms: pose generation and preview latency checks
priorities.gain: Potential control and viewport improvement without lowering quality; current owner loop and snapshot correctness must be validated

priorities.direction: Persistent formal worker and persistent sensor resources across sessions
mechanisms: safe draining and lease state machine
priorities.gain: Avoid repeated engine/context/asset initialization; keepalive source evidence cannot substitute for destination benchmarks

priorities.direction: Evaluate Fabric runtime pose path and pooled asynchronous D2H after new profiling
priorities.gain: Research track; do not bypass USD consumers or reuse live SDK buffers unsafely

priorities.direction: Dual-GPU offline group sharding after interactive viewport exits
priorities.gain: Potential throughput gain with both GPUs; shared CPU/IO and warmup costs limit scaling

experiment_plan: Same dual host baseline: owner GPU0 and capture GPU0 vs capture GPU1; identical quality, asset hash, trajectory and sensor list
Add CPU worker caps only; then interactive async only; then resident worker/resource reuse only
Measure idle, continuous key control, job startup, steady capture, pause/stop drain, job end and repeated jobs separately

Record P95/P99/max command acknowledgement, owner frame intervals, >100ms and >500ms stalls, per-GPU utilization and memory, phase CPU time, cgroup throttling deltas, queue occupancy and worker startup/exit
Validate all 13 LiDAR and 4 images per group, frame/clock/pose agreement, trajectory correspondence, quality and repeated-session cleanup
End-to-end browser input to viewport display latency must be measured separately from engine command acknowledgement
limits: No dual-GPU speedup or interactive end-to-end latency measured in this research
P2P support does not mean existing SDK performs transfers on the intended devices
CUDA copy-engine capability does not establish RTX producer buffer lifetime or completed asynchronous transfers
Current installed Isaac is 6.0.1-rc.7; latest documentation APIs require local availability checks
